user.title: Connect Windhager system
user.description: IP address of the system and the service password. The user name is always USER.

scope.title: Choose scope
scope.description: Which levels should be included? Info and operator level are always included. Service and factory level contain expert parameters - wrong values can disturb the system.

data_description.levels: Info: readings. Operator: mode, setpoints, programs. Service: heating curve, limits, screed program. Factory: combustion control, ignition, drives.
data_description.enable_advanced: Unchecked, the entities are created but stay disabled and cause no polling.
data_description.writable_advanced: Unchecked, these parameters are shown read-only.
data_description.update_interval: How often the system is queried.

reauth_confirm.title: Update password
reauth_confirm.description: System {host} rejected the login. Please enter the service password again.

init.title: Change scope
init.description: Changes apply immediately; the system is read again.
